meta.title: {brand} — your portrait in thread, made by hand
meta.description: A kit to make the portrait of someone you love yourself, with one black thread and 240 nails. Our software works out every pass of the thread from your photo.

announcement: Cash on delivery available in Algeria

hero.title: Your photo, woven thread by thread.
hero.lead: A kit to make the portrait of someone you love yourself, with one black thread and 240 nails. Our software works out every pass of the thread from your photo.
hero.boardLabel: Portrait being woven, computed by our software

how.title: From photo to artwork
how.lead: No drawing skills needed: just follow the nail numbers.

order.title: Order the kit
order.text: You receive the board with the nails already in place, the thread and your personal code.

photo.title: Add your photo
photo.text: Enter your code, then pick a photo. The face is framed automatically and you can adjust it.

choose.title: Pick your version
choose.text: Compare the soft, standard and high-contrast previews, then confirm the one you like.

make.title: Run the thread, guided by voice
make.text: The guide calls out each nail: A1, then C47, then B12… Set the pace and pause whenever you like.

kit.title: What's in the kit
kit.lead: Everything you need for a 50 × 50 cm portrait.

board.title: The 50 × 50 cm board
board.text: 240 nails already set in a circle, split into four zones A, B, C and D.

thread.title: The black thread
thread.text: One spool, enough for the full length of your portrait.

code.title: Your personal code
code.text: It lets you create your portrait from your own photo.

guide.title: The making guide
guide.text: On your phone, in French, English or Arabic, with voice.

gift.title: A gift you make yourself
gift.text: Give the kit with its code: they choose their photo and make their portrait. Or make it yourself and give the finished artwork.

skills.q: Do I need to know how to draw?
skills.a: No. You run the thread from one nail to the next in the order the guide calls out. No artistic skill is needed.

photo.a: A sharp, front-facing, well-lit photo with a single face. The software warns you if it is blurry, too dark or too bright.

privacy.a: It is only used to compute your portrait. It is never published and is deleted after a limited period.

time.a: Several hours, at your own pace. The guide saves your progress so you pick up where you left off.

payment.a: In Algeria, cash on delivery is available. Other payment methods depend on your country.

footer.tagline: Thread portraits to make at home.
